answer.says: Ramesh, the food is sufficient. I will eat, and then we shall settle the matter of the dhobi before I depart.
answer.thought: The body demands its due, and the spirit must not neglect it. I will eat this simple meal, for strength is required for the walk to the Directorate in the afternoon. The heat is manageable, but the bureaucracy will be closed or half-opened, and I must be sharp to press the matter of the vouchers.
